scope: Archive 008, the system messages Rockman speaks: effect-expired, rail, a garbled-speech pair, two mail deliveries with their bodies, and the new-game-plus line. Identical in both revisions. This is the last Japanese dialogue left on the established cold route.
provenance: Claude translator-authored Japanese to Korean, 2026-09-20; no independent review yet
tone: Rockman speaks to Netto as a friend (반말). Chaud's mail is clipped and formal-flat; Mom's is flustered.
notes: script/4 is the same rail warning spoken through static: each line is garbled first and repeated in parentheses. The Korean keeps that shape, garbling with the ㅂ series and matching the syllable count of its own parenthetical. script/0 and script/1 are a split message with an item name inserted between the literals, so the Korean puts the particle after the closing bracket. script/22 has a number inserted before its last literal.
